narrativeVibe: Dark, neon-drenched cyberpunk — gritty, stylish and dangerous.
scenario: Night City eats the weak. You're a street runner scraping by on gigs, chrome and nerve, caught between ruthless corporations, gangs and your own fading humanity.
start: Rain hisses on the fire escapes above. Your fixer just pinged you a job: a datashard that someone rich is willing to kill for. {{user}}, what do you do?
imageStyleTags: (masterpiece:1.2), cinematic, cyberpunk concept art, ((Cyberpunk)), high detail, moody
imageNegativeTags: low quality, fused digits, bad anatomy, watermark, text

defs.label: Body
defs.hint: Physical might and toughness — brawling, lifting, absorbing hits
defs.rules: Physical might and toughness. Used for brawling, lifting, grappling and absorbing damage that would floor lesser folk.

defs.label: Reflexes
defs.hint: Speed and reaction — gunplay, dodging, cyber-augmented movement
defs.rules: Speed, reaction time and hand-eye coordination. Used for gunplay, dodging, quick draws and lightning-fast movement.

defs.label: Intellect
defs.hint: Logic and data — hacking, deduction, code
defs.rules: Logic, deduction and data-crunching. Used for hacking, coding, research and unraveling conspiracies.

defs.label: Technical
defs.hint: Engineering and craft — building gear, modding chrome, fixing tech
defs.rules: Engineering skill. Used to build and repair gear, install and maintain cyberware, and jury-rig machines.

defs.label: Cool
defs.hint: Nerve under pressure — staying calm, resisting fear and intimidation
defs.rules: Nerve and composure. Used to stay calm under fire, resist fear and intimidation, and keep a cool head in negotiations.

defs.label: Empathy
defs.hint: Reading people — insight, connections, resisting dehumanization
defs.rules: Emotional intelligence. Used to read people, spot lies, build trust and resist the dehumanizing pull of chrome.

defs.label: Perception
defs.hint: Street awareness — spotting danger, surveillance, hidden things
defs.rules: Awareness and street instincts. Used to spot tails, hidden threats and surveillance, and to notice small telling details.

defs.label: Streetwise
defs.hint: The underground — knowing gangs, contacts, black markets
defs.rules: Knowledge of the criminal underground. Used to navigate gangs, find contacts, buy on the black market and know who runs what.

defs.label: Chrome
defs.hint: Cyberware affinity — capacity, control, resistance to chrome psychosis
defs.rules: Affinity with cyberware. Determines how much chrome the hero can safely carry and how well they control their implants.

defs.label: Luck
defs.hint: Fortune — wild chances, favorable coincidences and narrow escapes
defs.rules: Fortune and fate. Used to nudge uncertain outcomes, find favorable coincidences and slip through narrow escapes.

trackers.rules: Where the hero currently is — district, building or street. Short and specific, e.g. "Watson — Afterlife bar", "Kabuki, market alley". Update whenever the scene moves.

trackers.label: Quest
trackers.rules: The hero's single current active job, one short phrase — e.g. "Rip the data from Arasaka tower". Only ONE at a time: when done or abandoned, replace it, or leave empty.

trackers.label: Lvl
trackers.rules: The hero's level. Grant a level-up when exp is full.

trackers.label: Exp
trackers.rules: Experience toward the next level. Award exp for completed jobs and victories. When exp fills to its max of 100 the hero levels up and exp resets to 0.

trackers.label: HP
trackers.rules: Hit points — the hero's health. Damage reduces it; med-stims or rest restore it. If it reaches 0 the hero is downed or in peril. Max derives from Body.

trackers.label: Eddies
trackers.rules: The hero's money in eddies (€$). Track purchases, gig payouts and bribes here.

trackers.label: Chrome
trackers.rules: How much cyberware the hero has installed, as a load against their Chrome capacity. Installing more costs capacity; exceeding it strains the body and costs Humanity.

trackers.label: Heat
trackers.rules: How much attention the hero has drawn from cops and corps, 0-100. Crimes and loud stunts raise it; laying low lowers it. At high values they're hunted.

trackers.label: Humanity
trackers.rules: The hero's remaining humanity, 0-100. Installing chrome and brutal acts lower it; losing it all means losing yourself to the machine.

trackers.label: Street Cred
trackers.rules: Reputation in the underworld, 0-100. Grows with successful gigs and bold moves. High street cred opens doors and prices.
